title: Thread page with WebAuthn browser login

story.i_want_to: read a thread from one URL and write messages and findings on it
story.so_that: the work is visible without GitHub

rationale: PRD §6.1; loopctl has no authenticated browser session today.

acceptance_criteria.description: Browser login uses the WebAuthn credential enrolled at signup and binds the session to the tenant's human user principal, with CSRF protection and RLS scoped as for that principal.
The thread page shows checkpoints, entries (rendered as untrusted text) and findings, and fetches diffs from the forge by SHA without storing them.
The page writes message and finding entries with a per-form nonce as idempotency key, attributed to the human principal with an empty lineage.
The intake issue receives a link to the thread page.

test_cases.name: login
expected_results: session bound to the human principal
